channel.title: Dlonem news
channel.description: Releases and patch notes for the Dlonem apps and CK3 mods, and studio news.

item.title: THC Break Buddy 1.0.52: Android: a slip costs what the research supports
item.description: A logged use now takes a dent sized to the dose instead of a reset, shown in points. One slip no longer restarts a regular user's whole drug test window, and the daily brief only says you're near baseline when you really are.

item.title: Dlonem: A beginner's guide to WoW Forever
item.description: What returning players get wrong, which class to start with, how leveling, camping and professions work, Group Finder and Hall of Thanes, and Hardcore. Facts checked against Blizzard's own posts.

item.title: Dlonem: The Supernatural wiki goes up
item.description: The whole mod on one page: every creature, every lifestyle perk tree by tree, the magic system with all 54 magic interactions and the four magic activities, the game rules, and the known issues.

item.title: THC Break Buddy 1.0.51: iOS: the September update arrives
item.description: Everything Android got on 30 September: smart reminders on the days that are usually yours, a note the morning a badge unlocks, a new daily brief every day, and a break can be marked as quitting for good.

item.title: Supernatural 2.37: The Six Hides
item.description: Six ancient wolf hides choose Champions of their own, and werewolves run in packs now, with an alpha, a Second and a Werewolf Gathering.

item.title: Supernatural 2.36: Crusader Kings III 1.20
item.description: Supernatural runs on CK3 1.20: the creature doctrines live on rites, and your rite judges what you do once it knows what you are.

item.title: The Grey Company: The Grey Company
item.description: A guild for World of Warcraft: Forever, which launches on 4 November. Alliance, Normal ruleset, NA servers, leveling and social, every time zone welcome. The Discord is open now, and dlonem.com/grey is the address to give people in game.

item.title: Dlonem: Engaged
item.description: In September, on our trip to Italy, I asked my girlfriend of four years to marry me. She said yes.

item.title: THC Break Buddy 1.0.50: Android: reminders that arrive once
item.description: Reminders fire once, at the time you picked, in any time zone. Smart reminders give a heads-up on the days that are usually yours, the daily brief is new every day, and a break can now be marked as quitting for good.

item.title: Nicotine Break Buddy 1.0.12: The craving-window nudge works
item.description: The nudge is timed to the trigger you told the app about. Reminders arrive once, at the time you picked, and badges earned overnight are announced when you open the app. New premium theme: Mint.

item.title: Caffeine Break Buddy 1.0.21: Your estimate follows what you log
item.description: The progress estimate moves in proportion to how much caffeine you log. Reminders arrive once, at the time you picked, the cutoff reminder works, and milestone alerts arrive when a badge unlocks. New premium theme: Rooibos.

item.title: The Long Night & Azor Ahai 1.1.3: The Player Reports
item.description: There is one Night King now: cast down by anything but a bane, he rises again in the same face and name. The September bug reports are traced and fixed.

item.title: Supernatural 2.35a: The witch you let live
item.description: Turning down a witch hunt no longer kills the witch, and the world stops filling with new hunters and werewolves.

item.title: The Long Night & Azor Ahai 1.1.2: The Cold Does Not Fall
item.description: The Night King no longer dies by accident, and the mod is in Spanish and French as well.

item.title: The Long Night & Azor Ahai 1.1.1: The Watch Keeps No Land
item.description: A sworn brother renounces any land he inherits outside the Wall, the Lord Commander included.

item.title: Dlonem: The Long Night wiki goes up
item.description: Every mechanic in the mod, with the numbers, on one page: how the invasion runs, coming back from the dead, the Night's Watch, the Last Hour, every game rule and decision.

item.title: Supernatural 2.35: The Hunt
item.description: A kill leaves a mark on the county it happened in. One body is usually just a body; a second inside the year is not, and the county starts talking.

item.title: THC Break Buddy 1.0.50: iOS: purchases land where they should
item.description: Premium status now syncs directly with your App Store purchase, and anyone who bought it before can restore it from Settings at no charge.

item.title: Compatibility Patch 1.1.3a: Re-checked against today's AGOT update
item.description: Re-checked against today's AGOT update

item.title: The Long Night & Azor Ahai 1.1.0b: Keeping pace with A Game of Thrones
item.description: A hotfix for AGOT's 0.5.2 hotfix. The dead no longer spend a second winter proving a war they have already won.

item.title: THC Break Buddy 1.0.49: Your profile can move down, not just up
item.description: If your logs look lighter the app offers to move your tier down — always your call. Finished a break by accident? Resume it. The recovery graph now shows the whole break, relapses included.

item.title: Tiny Dragon Hoard 1.0.40: One notification at a time
item.description: Notices take turns instead of stacking, and never land over a menu or a take-off. “Welcome back” only appears when you were really away, and after a Keep Flying ad the sky waits for your tap.

item.title: The Long Night & Azor Ahai 1.1.0a: One Host
item.description: The dead stop fighting the dead. Twelve fixes, no new content.

item.title: The Long Night & Azor Ahai 1.1.0: The Last Hour
item.description: Reaching the Night King opens a Trial-of-Seven-style melee: you and your companions against him, on foot, in the snow. Lose and he keeps you.

item.title: Supernatural 2.34: The Blood Remembers Who
item.description: Every turning is remembered — dated, in your own words, naming the one who did it.

item.title: The Long Night & Azor Ahai 1.0.16a: The Wanderer
item.description: The Night King keeps his land. The invasion had been handing him his counties before it handed him his realm.

item.title: The Long Night & Azor Ahai 1.0.16: The Dead That Frighten You
item.description: The Others get culture traditions and an innovation history — they had neither.

item.title: Supernatural 2.33: The Blood Remembers
item.description: The blood catches the blow that would have killed you: a mortal carrying vampire blood who takes a fatal hit as a knight does not simply die.

item.title: Compatibility Patch 1.1.3: The dead are outside magic's reach
item.description: The species gate now recognises every one of them.

item.title: Nicotine Break Buddy 1.0.11: The estimate reacts to what you log
item.description: Logging a use moves your recovery estimate in proportion to how much you used, and clean days rebuild it at the same rate as before. A clean break shows exactly the number it always did.
